minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 1325 Mass Ave site plan waiver to March 9, awaiting the building official's written ruling.
minutes.summary: The board heard a resident ask about the solar bylaw, continued the 1325 Mass Ave stormwater hearing and a site plan waiver request to March 9, and approved a de minimis slope change at 496 Mass Ave. It reviewed draft earth removal regulations and stormwater bylaw edits, discussed the Community Preservation Act and the Brooks House, and voted to invite the Board of Selectmen to the March 23 meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board said it would not act on the 1325 Mass Ave site plan waiver without the building official's written letter, and carried it to March 9.
The board voted to continue the 1325 Mass Ave stormwater public hearing to March 9 at the applicant's request.
The board approved a de minimis change at 496 Mass Ave that alters a slope, with the vote passing.
The board set earth removal regulation hours for residential areas and reviewed draft stormwater bylaw edits, including a per-acre application fee with a maximum.
The board voted to invite the Board of Selectmen to the March 23 meeting about the master plan and Brooks House.

why_it_matters: Earth removal hours and stormwater application fees are rules that would apply to nearby construction and to what applicants pay, and the 1325 Mass Ave waiver stays undecided until the building official's letter arrives.
A resident raised the solar bylaw and said he may bring a warrant article, so the bylaw's screening and property value language could come to a Town Meeting vote.
